description: Fail closed: a missing or failing git guard blocks the Bash call (exit 2). SessionStart, the Python check and the implement-plan skill's Stop hook warn instead (exit 1) when their script is missing, since exit 2 on Stop would trap the session.

hooks.command: g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/git-guard.sh"; [ -x "$g" ] || { echo "git-guard: $g is missing or not executable; Bash is blocked until it is back" >&2; exit 2; }; "$g" || exit 2
c="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/py-check.sh"; [ -x "$c" ] || { echo "py-check: $c is missing or not executable; edited Python files are not checked" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$c"
b="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/agent-bus.sh"; [ -x "$b" ] || { echo "agent-bus: $b is missing or not executable; peers are not listed" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$b" hook session-start
